findings.finding: All 27 standing assumptions have formal expression A_LIFE,k=top. These expressions do not verify the substantive prose obligations (complete dependencies, resource completeness, model applicability, sound checker). A production checker must implement actual predicates and preserve unresolved assumptions; a top token cannot establish them.

Fiber membership is defined by C_LIFE ACCEPT, and HYP-LIFE34(18) assumes that acceptance. The release theorem is a conditional assembly result, not a construction/proof of a physical lifecycle checker. Scheduler and domain evaluation bodies remain named operations requiring implemented model kernels and independently checked inputs.

Do not equate imperfect repair with new-state renewal, completed work with improvement, physical repairability with executable repair, or local retrofit improvement with system improvement. Recheck every dependent acceptance claim/interface after changed semantic roots. Exact incremental/cold equality requires complete dependencies, deterministic derivations, and immutable versions.

m/L and (dcrit-d)/L require explicit handling of L>0, nonnegative valid margin/current-damage bounds, threshold conventions, and applicability of a worst-case rate bound. L=0 must not silently divide; an absent bound is UNKNOWN rather than a mean-based guarantee. Renewal-reward cost needs a declared iid lifetime model with finite positive expected cycle length and declared costs.

O(y|c) is written as an observation kernel/likelihood and later used as an observation map in factorization. An implementation must distinguish these types, define positive support/density semantics for continuous observations, intersect with the prior condition set as THM-LIFE3 requires, and enforce actions constant on equal information histories. The displayed condition-set definition alone omits the prior restriction.

DEF-LIFE39 defines Obs as a versioned tuple, but THM-LIFE23 formula uses Obs=top and implies the whole repair fiber empty. Prose proves only the case where every compatible spare/tool or every available repair action is blocked. One obsolete part with another executable compatible repair is a counterexample to an unqualified global implication. Preserve prose existential possibility; require universal action-blocking evidence before certifying an empty repair fiber.

Whole-project lifecycle release requires all 18 local premises, including accepted handover baseline, typed asset/configuration records, model applicability, nonanticipativity, resources, spares/supplier dependence, drift, decommissioning, circularity and dependency closure. Preserve assumptions, waivers, UNKNOWN, limitations, supersessions and recertification triggers. Present routing/IFC verification cannot be promoted into a PCLAI release absent these bodies and evidence.

Lean-style sketch references undefined independentChecker, dependencyComplete, derivations and release functions; it is not a standalone compilable mechanized proof. Formalized status must remain unverified until compiled with actual definitions and obligations.
